description: Cascade OOD eval on 9 held-out sources, comparing our own cascade checkpoint WITHOUT real-host synthetic training (146_cascade_randomfg_predprior_regoff, from 2b_cascade_val) against WITH real-host synthetic training (168_cascade_real_host_all_shapes, resumed from 167's real-host checkpoint into cascade mode -- see docs/logs.md 2026-09-28), plus Medverse released weights at depth-matched native-AR inference (from 2c_cascade_medverse's own wandb runs, re-verified against results_cascade.tex's tab:cascade-medverse: all 5 available sources reproduce the paper's cited macro Dice to 3 decimal places once aggregated as macro, not micro). All three stages use eval.split=test, data.mask_downsample=occupancy, macro Dice (mean of per-class means). 168's eval.tasks_per_class=20 override was a no-op for every one of these 9 native-grid sources (same known bug as the 160-167 sweep, confirmed here by sample counts matching 146's full-test-set counts exactly for all 9 sources) -- so despite the 'smallslice' wandb.name suffix, 168's numbers here are full-dataset, directly comparable to 146's. isles22/shifts_ms/atlas_v2/gnc_kidney have no Medverse row: the paper deliberately excludes them ('both models score too low to be informative'), and no depth-matched Medverse attempt was ever launched for them (verified: no matching wandb runs found, not a crash). TotalSeg CT/MRI are out of scope for this OOD comparison (146/168 are eval'd on the 9 held-out sources only).
